criteria: The introduction identifies the product and demonstrated objective coherently.
Actions occur in a natural order and typing is visibly progressive.
Relevant dropdown, date, and time-slot interactions visibly open and select.
The complete requested outcome remains visible long enough to understand.
Captions explain verified workflow value rather than reading controls.
Cursor travel, scrolling, camera focus, and transitions feel intentional.
No blank frame, slideshow freeze, stutter, crop, or caption obstruction is visible.
The final result is comparable in coherence and polish to the approved sample set.
